unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The wheels on the bus go round and round.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: wheel（车轮）滚动时发出“微——”(wiːl)的声音。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Turn left and go straight on.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: l-e-f-t：左边(left)有一只大象(elephant)的脚印。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Turn left and go straight on.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: straight（笔直地）里藏着“ai”，就像一条笔直的爱心大道。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 图书室; 图书馆
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Here's the library.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: li（里）+ brary（布雷瑞）——图书馆里有很多书。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Here's the sports centre.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: centre（中心）和 enter（进入）押韵，进入建筑物的中心。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Turn left and turn right. Walk along TC Road. Then you can find a cinema.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: si-ne-ma（西内妈）——西边的奶奶去电影院看电影。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: At the hospital, she turns right.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: hos（好死）+ pi（皮）+ tal（台）——生病了去医院，医生帮你调理身体。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: You can see a supermarket on your left.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: super（超级的）+ market（市场）= 超级市场。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 博物馆, 博物院
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Susu goes straight on to the museum.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: mu（木）+ se（色）+ um（姆）——博物馆里展出了很多木头雕刻的艺术品。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Let's find out tomorrow.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: to（去）+ morrow（嘛喽）——明天那只嘛喽要去上学。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 成年女子, 妇女
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Your cat visits me every day.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: wo（我）+ man（男人）变成 wo + man（女人）。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What is Yanyan's birthday wish?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: wish（愿望）：W（我）+ ish（爱死）——我爱死这个愿望了。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 步; 一步(的距离)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Remember, go straight on, walk 50 steps...
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: s-t-e-p：踏出的每一步都稳稳当当。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I want to go to school on my own!
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: own（自己的）——噢(o)！这(wn)是我的东西！

unit_vocabulary.comparison: on one's own vs by oneself
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I want to go to school on my own!
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 靠自己（on one's own）去完成任务。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Cross the road.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: c-r-o-s-s：像一个十字路口，我们要横穿（cross）马路。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Be careful, my girl!
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: care（关心、小心）+ ful（充满的）= 小心谨慎的。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Be careful when you cross the street.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 走路要当心，be careful。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It goes underground.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: under（在……下面）+ ground（地面）= 地下的。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Here's the sports centre.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: sports（运动）+ centre（中心）= 体育中心。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Turn left and go straight on.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: turn（转弯）+ left（左边）= 向左转。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Turn right and go straight on.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: turn（转弯）+ right（右边）= 向右转。

unit_vocabulary.comparison: go straight on vs go back
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Go straight on to the museum.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 一直（straight）向前（go on）走。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What is Yanyan's birthday wish?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: birth（出生）+ day（日子）= 生日。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Cross the road.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: r-o-a-d：路上有一只老 toad（蟾蜍）。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: But how do we get around the city?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: ci-ty（市区、城市）：美丽的城市人人爱。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: There is a train.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: t-r-a-i-n：火车在铁轨上呜呜开过。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Here's a map of the city.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: m-a-p：妈妈（mum）的苹果（apple）拼成一张地图。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Make a model of your dream town.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: t-o-w-n：兔子（rabbit）在小镇（town）里玩。
